Code of Conduct

SITCON Summer Camp is committed to providing a friendly and open environment for every member of the community. We believe that every participant in community activities deserves respect, and we will do our best to provide the safest environment possible, allowing participants to support each other, grow together, and shine with the light of their lives within the community.

Therefore, we hope that all participants will read the following code of conduct to help build a friendly community together.

Community Guidelines

  • Respect every participant and keep their feelings in mind.
  • Avoid using language and gestures that are insulting, discriminatory, or harassing in nature.
  • Pay more attention to those around you and appropriately ask if they need assistance.
  • When encountering danger or noticing something wrong, seek support and assistance from staff members in a timely manner.
  • Interact more with others during the activity and cherish the time spent together!

The Following Behaviors Are Not Allowed

  • Provocation or offense regarding gender, sexual orientation, race, appearance, religion, age, physical condition, or personal identity.
  • Any form of sexual harassment, verbal or physical bullying.
  • Public statements, displays, or screenings of speech, images, or recordings that contain insults, discrimination, hatred, violence, or sexual innuendo.
  • Disrupting the normal progress of courses, sessions, or activities without reason, ignoring the restraints of staff members or others.
  • Interfering with or attacking the network provided at the venue, recording courses without consent, and other behaviors that disrupt the normal progress of activities.

Handling Violations of the Code

If any of the above situations occur, we will take the following actions:

  • Verbal apology on the spot.
  • Leaving the venue immediately.
  • Cancellation of qualifications or rights.
  • Legal responsibilities will be handled according to the law.

Contact Information

If you encounter any problems, please don't hesitate to contact our staff. You can also reach us through the following methods:

  • General Contact: contact@sitcon.org
  • Registration Matters: ask@sitcon.camp
